prompt: Q: Who can I ____ at this gym? A: ____ in a few minutes.
answer: talk to about getting a membership / Someone will help you
full_sentence: Q: Who can I talk to about getting a membership at this gym? A: Someone will help you in a few minutes.
translation_ko: 이 체육관의 회원권 가입에 대해 누구와 이야기할 수 있나요? / 누군가가 몇 분 내로 당신을 도와줄 거예요.

prompt: Q: Which ____ in the catalog? A: I ____.
answer: oven did you buy from the items / ordered the cheapest one
full_sentence: Q: Which oven did you buy from the items in the catalog? A: I ordered the cheapest one.
translation_ko: 카탈로그에 있는 물건들 중에서 어떤 오븐을 구매하셨나요? / 저는 가장 저렴한 것을 주문했어요.

prompt: Q: What do you think ____? A: Multiple ____.
answer: I should take to the job fair / copies of your résumé
full_sentence: Q: What do you think I should take to the job fair? A: Multiple copies of your résumé.
translation_ko: 취업 박람회에 제가 무엇을 가져가야 한다고 생각하세요? / 여러 장의 이력서요.

prompt: Q: Who ____? A: The ____.
answer: conducted the job interview / head of human resources
full_sentence: Q: Who conducted the job interview? A: The head of human resources.
translation_ko: 누가 취업 면접을 진행했나요? / 인사부장이요.

prompt: Q: What were ____? A: Mr. Hans ____.
answer: last month's sales numbers / keeps track of that
full_sentence: Q: What were last month's sales numbers? A: Mr. Hans keeps track of that.
translation_ko: 지난달 판매 수치는 얼마였나요? / Mr. Hans가 그것에 대해 계속 파악하고 있어요.

prompt: Q: Which dessert ____? A: I'm ____.
answer: are you going to order / still trying to decide
full_sentence: Q: Which dessert are you going to order? A: I'm still trying to decide.
translation_ko: 어떤 후식을 주문할 건가요? / 저는 아직 결정하는 중이에요.

prompt: Q: Where are ____? A: In ____.
answer: the extra chairs stored / the basement storage room
full_sentence: Q: Where are the extra chairs stored? A: In the basement storage room.
translation_ko: 여분의 의자들은 어디에 보관되어 있나요? / 지하 창고 안에요.

prompt: Q: When is ____? A: You have ____.
answer: the checkout time at this hotel / until noon tomorrow
full_sentence: Q: When is the checkout time at this hotel? A: You have until noon tomorrow.
translation_ko: 이 호텔의 체크아웃 시간은 언제인가요? / 내일 정오까지 시간이 있어요.

prompt: Q: Where ____? A: I ____.
answer: should I stay while in Paris / haven't been there
full_sentence: Q: Where should I stay while in Paris? A: I haven't been there.
translation_ko: 제가 파리에 있는 동안 어디에 머물러야 할까요? / 저는 그곳에 가본 적이 없어요.

prompt: Q: When will ____? A: ____.
answer: the review of the application be posted / Right after lunch
full_sentence: Q: When will the review of the application be posted? A: Right after lunch.
translation_ko: 애플리케이션에 대한 검토 결과는 언제 게시할 것인가요? / 점심 직후요.

prompt: Q: When will ____? A: I need ____.
answer: the budget proposal be ready / a little more time
full_sentence: Q: When will the budget proposal be ready? A: I need a little more time.
translation_ko: 예산안은 언제 준비될까요? / 저는 조금 더 시간이 필요해요.

prompt: Q: Where did ____? A: I ____.
answer: you park your car / took the bus today
full_sentence: Q: Where did you park your car? A: I took the bus today.
translation_ko: 당신의 차를 어디에 주차했나요? / 저는 오늘 버스를 탔어요.

prompt: Q: Why are we ____? A: Because ____.
answer: switching to the new software system / our current one is outdated
full_sentence: Q: Why are we switching to the new software system? A: Because our current one is outdated.
translation_ko: 왜 우리는 새로운 소프트웨어 시스템으로 전환하려는 것인가요? / 현재의 것이 오래됐기 때문이에요.

prompt: Q: How do you ____? A: I think ____.
answer: feel about the new office layout / it improves collaboration
full_sentence: Q: How do you feel about the new office layout? A: I think it improves collaboration.
translation_ko: 새로운 사무실 배치에 대해 어떻게 생각하세요? / 그것이 협업을 향상시킨다고 생각해요.

prompt: Q: How are you ____ on Saturday? A: Maybe Brett ____.
answer: getting to the art festival / will give me a ride
full_sentence: Q: How are you getting to the art festival on Saturday? A: Maybe Brett will give me a ride.
translation_ko: 당신은 토요일 예술 축제에 어떻게 가실 건가요? / 아마도 Brett이 저를 태워줄 거예요.

prompt: Q: Why wasn't ____? A: Are ____?
answer: our newsletter mailed to customers / you sure it wasn't
full_sentence: Q: Why wasn't our newsletter mailed to customers? A: Are you sure it wasn't?
translation_ko: 왜 우리의 소식지가 고객들에게 우편으로 발송되지 않았나요? / 발송되지 않은 것이 확실한가요?

prompt: Q: How should we ____? A: Let's ____.
answer: arrange the desks for the seminar / put them in a circle
full_sentence: Q: How should we arrange the desks for the seminar? A: Let's put them in a circle.
translation_ko: 세미나를 위해 책상들을 어떻게 배치해야 할까요? / 원형으로 배치합시다.

prompt: Q: Why did you ____? A: Because ____ regularly.
answer: cancel your gym membership / I've been too busy to go
full_sentence: Q: Why did you cancel your gym membership? A: Because I've been too busy to go regularly.
translation_ko: 당신은 왜 체육관 회원권을 취소했나요? / 정기적으로 가기에 제가 너무 바쁘기 때문이에요.

prompt: Q: Do you know ____? A: It's ____ downtown.
answer: where the new Italian restaurant is located / next to the movie theater
full_sentence: Q: Do you know where the new Italian restaurant is located? A: It's next to the movie theater downtown.
translation_ko: 어디에 새로운 이탈리아 식당이 위치해 있는지 아시나요? / 시내 영화관 옆에 있어요.

prompt: Q: Haven't you ____ during your stay? A: We're ____.
answer: visited the national park / planning to go tomorrow
full_sentence: Q: Haven't you visited the national park during your stay? A: We're planning to go tomorrow.
translation_ko: 체류하는 동안 국립공원을 방문하지 않으셨나요? / 저희는 내일 가려고 계획하고 있어요.

prompt: Q: Can I ____? A: Sorry, but ____.
answer: take pictures in the art gallery / that's prohibited
full_sentence: Q: Can I take pictures in the art gallery? A: Sorry, but that's prohibited.
translation_ko: 미술관에서 사진을 찍어도 될까요? / 죄송하지만, 그건 금지되어 있어요.

prompt: Q: Shouldn't ____ of the pamphlet? A: The ____.
answer: we make another 10 copies / printer is out of ink
full_sentence: Q: Shouldn't we make another 10 copies of the pamphlet? A: The printer is out of ink.
translation_ko: 우리는 팸플릿 10부를 추가로 만들어야 하지 않나요? / 프린터에 잉크가 떨어졌어요.

prompt: Q: Has ____ recently? A: I ____.
answer: a new fitness machine been added / just joined this gym
full_sentence: Q: Has a new fitness machine been added recently? A: I just joined this gym.
translation_ko: 최근에 새로운 운동기구가 추가되었나요? / 저는 이 헬스장에 방금 등록했어요.

prompt: Q: Wasn't Devon ____? A: He's been ____.
answer: assigned to handle the customer service inquiries / transferred to the sales department
full_sentence: Q: Wasn't Devon assigned to handle the customer service inquiries? A: He's been transferred to the sales department.
translation_ko: Devon이 고객 서비스 문의를 처리하도록 배정되지 않았나요? / 그는 영업부로 이동했어요.

prompt: Q: Do you water the plants ____? A: I give them ____.
answer: daily or just once a week / water every three days
full_sentence: Q: Do you water the plants daily or just once a week? A: I give them water every three days.
translation_ko: 당신은 식물에 매일 물을 주나요, 아니면 일주일에 한 번만 주나요? / 3일마다 그것들에 물을 줘요.

prompt: Q: The client ____, was he? A: We ____.
answer: wasn't satisfied with our initial proposal / need to revise it
full_sentence: Q: The client wasn't satisfied with our initial proposal, was he? A: We need to revise it.
translation_ko: 고객이 우리의 첫 제안에 만족하지 않았어요, 그렇죠? / 우리는 그것을 수정해야 해요.

prompt: Q: ____ or the department store? A: Let's ____.
answer: Would you rather go to the mall / visit the mall
full_sentence: Q: Would you rather go to the mall or the department store? A: Let's visit the mall.
translation_ko: 당신은 쇼핑몰에 가고 싶어요, 아니면 백화점에 가고 싶어요? / 쇼핑몰을 방문합시다.

prompt: Q: Members ____, right? A: That is ____.
answer: get a 20 percent discount on their first purchase / no longer our policy
full_sentence: Q: Members get a 20 percent discount on their first purchase, right? A: That is no longer our policy.
translation_ko: 회원들은 첫 구매에 20퍼센트 할인을 받아요, 그렇죠? / 그것은 더 이상 우리의 정책이 아니에요.

prompt: Q: Will our client ____? A: Let me ____.
answer: arrive at the airport on Wednesday or Thursday / check her itinerary
full_sentence: Q: Will our client arrive at the airport on Wednesday or Thursday? A: Let me check her itinerary.
translation_ko: 우리 고객이 수요일에 공항에 도착할 건가요, 아니면 목요일에 도착할 건가요? / 제가 그녀의 여행 일정을 확인할게요.

prompt: Q: You ____, have you? A: I ____ last week.
answer: haven't booked the hotel yet / made the reservation
full_sentence: Q: You haven't booked the hotel yet, have you? A: I made the reservation last week.
translation_ko: 그 호텔을 아직 예약하지 않았어요, 그렇죠? / 지난주에 예약했어요.

prompt: Q: Would you ____ this Saturday? A: ____.
answer: mind covering my shift / I can do that
full_sentence: Q: Would you mind covering my shift this Saturday? A: I can do that.
translation_ko: 이번 주 토요일에 제 교대 근무를 맡아줄 수 있나요? / 제가 그렇게 할 수 있어요.

prompt: Q: I heard ____ again. A: The marketing team ____.
answer: the product launch had to be postponed / must still be adjusting something
full_sentence: Q: I heard the product launch had to be postponed again. A: The marketing team must still be adjusting something.
translation_ko: 제품 출시가 또 연기되어야 했다고 들었어요. / 마케팅 팀이 여전히 무언가를 조정하고 있을 거예요.

prompt: Q: Do you ____? A: ____, please.
answer: need me to distribute the handouts / On each desk
full_sentence: Q: Do you need me to distribute the handouts? A: On each desk, please.
translation_ko: 제가 유인물들을 나누어 줄까요? / 각 책상 위에 부탁드려요.

prompt: Q: ____ with me? A: No, thanks. I'm ____.
answer: How about sharing a taxi downtown / taking the bus
full_sentence: Q: How about sharing a taxi downtown with me? A: No, thanks. I'm taking the bus.
translation_ko: 저와 시내로 가는 택시를 함께 타는 게 어때요? / 고맙지만 사양할게요. 저는 버스를 탈 거예요.

prompt: Q: ____ for a meeting. A: ____.
answer: The client is waiting in front of the office / The manager is on her way
full_sentence: Q: The client is waiting in front of the office for a meeting. A: The manager is on her way.
translation_ko: 고객이 회의를 위해 사무실 앞에서 기다리고 있어요. / 관리자가 가는 중이에요.

prompt: Q: Let's ____. A: I have ____.
answer: begin planning the company retreat / some time after lunch
full_sentence: Q: Let's begin planning the company retreat. A: I have some time after lunch.
translation_ko: 회사 야유회 계획을 짜는 것을 시작합시다. / 저는 점심 이후에 시간이 있어요.
